title: Board: top-only → fixed pair → any two supported views

rounds.label: One view
rounds.attempt: The top-camera outline fit lost the rim.
rounds.diagnosis: Hands and pieces interrupted the visible boundary.
rounds.change: Fit the known board outline independently in front and rear images.
rounds.outcome: Recorded-packet checks recovered a top-view failure.

rounds.label: Fixed pair
rounds.attempt: The rear view became blocked during the transfer.
rounds.diagnosis: A fixed camera pair could still lose a required boundary.
rounds.change: Use any two independently supported current views, with the original acceptance checks.
rounds.outcome: Four previously rejected recorded packets were recovered.

rounds.label: Online use
rounds.attempt: Bind the multi-view result to the current observation.
rounds.outcome: The joined V13 execution recovered the rim from front + side views with close cross-view agreement.

front_rear_repair.note: One of the four recorded packets already passed the original top fit; do not count all four as recovered top failures.

any_two_repair.observation_type: Two independently supported views from the same current RGB packet; no historical pose is stamped as current.

scope: Board-pose perception module refined on recorded failures and then actually used by the joined policy observer. Cross-view disagreement is an image-estimator consistency measure, not a physical placement error or full-task generalization result.
